steps.title: Rahbar, Admin, Teacher, parent Telegram chegaralarini va v3 istisnolarini yozish
steps.acceptance: Rahbar/Admin/Teacher uchun kanal va amal jadvali mavjud; parent/student web login scope tashqarisida. Har PDF talabi manba sahifasi va R-IDga bog‘langan.

steps.title: Pro-rata, trial, freeze, discount, refund va payroll qoidalarini misollar bilan tasdiqlash
steps.acceptance: 480000×7/12=280000 misoli, trialning ikkinchi attendance transitioni, grant, freeze va refund hisoblari qarorlar bilan berilgan; noma’lum natija taxminiy PASS emas.

steps.title: Har talabga R-ID, rol, kirish, natija va sinov biriktirish
steps.acceptance: Har talabning kamida bitta owner stepi va tekshiriladigan natijasi bor; barcha 8 sahifa qamrovi tekshirilgan; qabul qiluvchi rol belgilangan.

steps.title: 240/250 demo, oy/12 dars, bot tasdiqlash, zaxira va xizmat darajasi noaniqliklarini yopish
steps.acceptance: D01–D18 holati PROPOSED/ACCEPTED/DEFERRED; egasi va qaysi stepni bloklashi bor. Moliya qarori ochiq bo‘lsa aynan unga bog‘liq step bloklanadi, butun repo emas.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Barcha ochiq moliyaviy qarorlar egasi bilan belgilangan; tasdiqlanmagan qoida kodga aylantirilmaydi

steps.title: Har markazga alohida API, worker, PostgreSQL, fayl hajmi va bot chegaralarini loyihalash
steps.acceptance: Center A va B uchun database credential, storage, bot va network chegarasi chizmada ko‘rsatilgan; shared VPS nosozlik domeni alohida yozilgan.

steps.title: UUID, version, foreign key, unique va immutable ledger jadvallarini ER diagrammada belgilash
steps.acceptance: Enrollment ko‘p guruhni, guardian ko‘p farzandni, lesson bir kunda ko‘p darsni qo‘llaydi. Ledger/invoice/allocation va audit o‘rtasidagi FKlar ko‘rsatilgan.

steps.title: Auth, students, groups, lessons, billing, payments, imports va sync kontraktlarini belgilash
steps.acceptance: Har write endpointda rol, body, error, idempotency yoki expected_version talabi bor; Teacher DTOda telefon yo‘q. OpenAPI parse/validationdan o‘tadi.

steps.title: Outbox hodisalari, idempotency, event version va retry semantikasini yozish
steps.acceptance: PaymentRecorded va AttendanceSubmitted schema versiyasi, outbox transaction, retry, dedup key, consumer va retentioni belgilangan. At-least-once chegarasi ochiq.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Har API uchun rol va xato kodi bor; boshqa markaz bazasiga marshrut yo‘q

steps.title: JS workspace va Flutter toolchainni alohida pin qilish, install/build buyruqlarini yaratish
steps.acceptance: Toza checkoutda belgilangan runtime bilan install va workspace build ishlaydi; Flutter alohida toolchain bo‘lib JS lockfilega kirmaydi.

steps.title: NestJS API health, config validation va request ID poydevorini yozish
steps.acceptance: Config yo‘q yoki noto‘g‘ri bo‘lsa xizmat aniq xato bilan startni rad etadi; health secret/DB password qaytarmaydi; request ID logda bor.

steps.title: Mahalliy PostgreSQL, API va worker servislarini secretsiz sozlash
steps.acceptance: Dev Compose healthcheckdan o‘tadi; DB tashqi internetga ochilmaydi; .env.example haqiqiy kalitsiz; lokal volume qayta startda saqlanadi.

steps.title: Lint, typecheck, test, build va maxfiy kalitlarni tekshirishni ulash
steps.acceptance: Atay buzilgan type/test bilan CI qizil, tuzatilganda yashil. Hali mavjud bo‘lmagan app uchun soxta PASS yoki barcha testlarni skip qilish yo‘q.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Toza checkout hujjatdagi buyruqlar bilan ishga tushadi; CI yashil

steps.title: Staff, student, guardian, enrollment, group, lesson, invoice, ledger, audit, outbox jadvallarini yaratish
steps.acceptance: DB modelda barcha invariant FK/unique bilan ifodalangan; student archive ledgerni cascade delete qilmaydi; guardian unlink qarzni o‘chirmaydi.

steps.title: FK, unique, check, indekslar va ledger UPDATE/DELETE cheklovlarini yozish
steps.acceptance: Runtime user ledger UPDATE/DELETE qila olmaydi; migrator user alohida. Invoice period va attendance lesson/student duplicate DB darajasida rad.

steps.title: Tranzaksiya chegarasi va parallel yozish xatolarini boshqarish
steps.acceptance: Payment transactionning o‘rtasida fault kiritilganda payment/allocation/audit/outboxning hammasi rollback; deadlock retry cheklangan va idempotent.

steps.title: Migratsiya, rollarning DB huquqlari, restore-compatible seed va cheklovlarni tekshirish
steps.acceptance: Bo‘sh DBga barcha migration, oldingi snapshotga yangi migration ishlaydi; schema drift aniqlanadi. Restore faylining format/version kontrakti qayd etilgan.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Bo‘sh bazada migratsiya o‘tadi; runtime DB roli ledgerni o‘chira olmaydi

steps.title: Parol hash, login limit, session revoke va birinchi kirishda parol almashtirishni yozish
steps.acceptance: Bruteforce limit, disabled staff, token rotation/revoke va logout tekshiriladi; browser sessiyasida CSRF siyosati, mobile token saqlash kontrakti bor.

steps.title: Director/Admin/Teacher huquqlari va har bir obyekt darajasidagi tekshiruvni yozish
steps.acceptance: Teacher A boshqa teacher guruh IDsi bilan GET/POST/export qila olmaydi; URLni almashtirish huquq bermaydi; API role va object scope tekshiradi.

steps.title: Xodim yaratish, o‘chirish o‘rniga deaktivatsiya va rol almashtirishni yozish
steps.acceptance: O‘zini oxirgi Director sifatida deaktivatsiya qilib markazni egasiz qoldirish rad; rol o‘zgarganda eski session vakolati yo‘qoladi; audit bor.

steps.title: Teacher boshqa guruhni, telefonni va moliyani ololmasligini sinash
steps.acceptance: Har role uchun allow/deny jadvali bajarilgan; pagination, search va error response orqali ham telefon/moliya sizib chiqmaydi.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: ID almashtirib kirish urinishlari 403/404; response va exportlarda ham shaxsiy telefon yashirilgan

steps.title: O‘quvchi yaratish, tahrir, archive va UUID asosidagi qidiruvni yozish
steps.acceptance: Bir xil create idempotency key bitta student; bir xil ismli turli student mumkin; archived student qidiruv defaultida yashirin, tarixda saqlanadi.

steps.title: Telefon normalizatsiyasi, ko‘p farzand va bir nechta vasiy munosabatini yozish
steps.acceptance: Bir guardian ikki farzandga bog‘lanadi, bir farzand ikki guardian bilan ishlaydi; guardian phone o‘zgarishida eski Telegram link avtomatik ishonchli qolmaydi.

steps.title: Trial/active/frozen/left holatlari va kursga a’zolik tarixini yozish
steps.acceptance: Faqat ruxsat etilgan status transitionlari; enrollmentning effective sanasi bor; guruh almashishda oldingi enrollment va moliya tarixi saqlanadi.

steps.title: Ism va telefon o‘xshashligini ogohlantirish; aka-ukalarni xato bloklamaslikni yozish
steps.acceptance: Bitta familiya/telefonli aka-ukalar bloklanmaydi; ehtimoliy dublikat Admin ko‘rigiga chiqadi; merge moliyaviy tarixni fizik o‘chirmaydi.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Bitta telefonli ikki farzand saqlanadi; bir o‘quvchini ikki marta qo‘shish aniqlanadi

steps.title: Kurs, narx tarixi, guruh va asosiy o‘qituvchini yaratish
steps.acceptance: Guruh narxi o‘zgarsa oldingi invoice snapshoti o‘zgarmaydi; yangi narx effective sanadan; teacher deaktivatsiyasida ochiq darslar ogohlantiriladi.

steps.title: Dars occurrence, timezone, bayram, ko‘chirilgan va bekor darsni modellashtirish
steps.acceptance: Bir kun ikki dars alohida lesson ID; reschedule eski IDni saqlaydi yoki aniq replacement relation; cancelled lesson ping/billingni noto‘g‘ri qo‘zg‘atmaydi.

steps.title: Faqat bitta dars uchun vaqtinchalik Teacher huquqi va haq egasini yozish
steps.acceptance: Substitute faqat belgilangan lessonni ko‘radi; ruxsat qaytarilganda offline yozuv reauth qilinadi; haq oluvchi assignment tarixda snapshot bo‘ladi.

steps.title: O‘z guruhida imtihon bali va izohlarni yozish, tarixni saqlash
steps.acceptance: Teacher faqat vakolatli lesson/enrollmentga baho qo‘yadi; diapazondan tashqari ball rad; izohlar XSSdan himoyalanadi; edit version conflict ko‘rinadi.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Bir kunda ikki dars to‘qnashmaydi; o‘rindosh huquqi darsdan tashqari amal qilmaydi

steps.title: Qolgan/to‘liq rejalashtirilgan dars ulushi bo‘yicha pro-rata va yaxlitlashni yozish
steps.acceptance: 480000×7/12=280000. Qolgan 0 dars →0; total=0 →hisob chiqarish bloklanadi. Yaxlitlash va narx effective sanasi ACCEPTED policyga mos.

steps.title: Kalendar oy, rolling month va 12-dars paketini alohida siyosat sifatida yozish
steps.acceptance: 12 dars va rolling month alohida: 31-yanvar renewal hamda cancelled lesson holati misollar bilan; calendar oy rejimi 1-sanaga bog‘langan.

steps.title: Ikkinchi haqiqiy qatnashuvda birinchi trialdan hisobni bir marta chiqarish
steps.acceptance: Birinchi trial present qarz yaratmaydi; ikkinchi distinct attended lesson bir marta activation beradi; attendance retry yangi invoice bermaydi. Correction uchun reversal siyosati bor.

steps.title: Davr uchun idempotent invoice, line item, narx snapshot va kredit qoldig‘ini yozish
steps.acceptance: Bir enrollment/davr/generator versiya qayta yugursa dublikat yo‘q; price/policy snapshot saqlanadi; service keyingi discount/freeze adjustmentlarini qabul qiladigan kontraktga ega.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: 480000 × 7/12 = 280000; qayta ishga tushirishda ikkinchi qarz yozilmaydi

steps.title: Foiz/fiks chegirma, sabab, muddat va oilaviy taklif yaratish
steps.acceptance: Admin so‘rov yaratadi lekin invoice o‘zgarmaydi; reason va expiry majburiy; percent 0–100; fixed discount summasi manfiy invoice yaratmaydi.

steps.title: Faqat rahbar tasdig‘i bilan qo‘llash; qo‘shilish tartibi va limitlarni yozish
steps.acceptance: Faqat Director approve; parallel ikki approve bitta effect; eskirgan/revoked request rad; stacking tartibi va tarixiy invoicega ta’sir siyosati testlangan.

steps.title: Freeze interval, dars kesishmasi va keyingi davr kreditini hisoblash
steps.acceptance: Overlap freeze double credit bermaydi; cancelled lesson uchun ikki kredit yo‘q; grant uchun sun’iy cash refund yo‘q; keyingi davr kredit allocationi auditda.

steps.title: Chiqish sanasi, besh sabab va yakuniy hisobni yozish
steps.acceptance: Chiqishning besh sababi majburiy; effective sanadan keyin yangi charge yo‘q; oldingi qarz saqlanadi; re-enrollment yangi tarix beradi.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Tasdiqsiz chegirma ishlamaydi; overlapping freeze ikki kredit bermaydi; grant qarzi nol

steps.title: Naqd/karta/Click/Payme/transfer qaydini pulning kichik birligida va tranzaksiyada yozish
steps.acceptance: Payment commit va outbox atomik; bir key+bir body bitta payment; bir key+boshqa amount 409; pul string/minor-unit bilan, float yo‘q.

steps.title: Qisman, ortiqcha va ko‘p invoicega taqsimlangan to‘lovni hisoblash
steps.acceptance: 500000 invoicega 300000 payment →200000 qarz; 600000 payment →0 qarz+100000 unapplied credit. Allocation yig‘indisi paymentdan oshmaydi.

steps.title: Sababli tuzatish so‘rovi, rahbar tasdig‘i va append-only reversal yaratish
steps.acceptance: 4000000 xato yozuv o‘chmaydi; Director tasdiqlangan reversal va 400000 yangi paymentdan keyin net400000. Partial refund va double approval ortiqcha qaytarishga yo‘l qo‘ymaydi.

steps.title: Noyob kvitansiya raqami va tasdiqlangan ledgerdan elektron kvitansiya yaratish
steps.acceptance: Kvitansiya ledger commitdan keyin yaratiladi; unique raqam, amount/method/date va remaining balance bor; fiscal chek deb belgilanmaydi; begona studentga berilmaydi.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Ikki parallel bir xil idempotency key bitta to‘lov yaratadi; reversal originalni o‘zgartirmaydi

steps.title: Kassa ochish, sanalgan pul, discrepancy va yopilgan smenani qulflash
steps.acceptance: Yopiq smenaga yangi naqd payment rad yoki yangi smena talab qiladi; parallel close bitta natija; counted va expected farqi reason/audit bilan.

steps.title: Xarajat toifasi, hujjat, vakolat va reversal bilan naqd chiqimini yozish
steps.acceptance: Expense uchun rol/sabab/summa talab qilinadi; reverse expense cash balancega bir marta ta’sir qiladi; karta expense naqdni kamaytirmaydi.

steps.title: Partial payment va promise atomik commandini integratsiya qilish, debt yopilganda eslatmani bekor qilish
steps.acceptance: Qisman payment+promise yaratish atomik command orqali: sana yo‘q bo‘lsa payment ham commit bo‘lmaydi. Qarz nol bo‘lganda eski promise CANCELLED.

steps.title: To‘lov usullari bo‘yicha tushum, kutilgan naqd va smena hisobotini yozish
steps.acceptance: Opening0+cash3200000-expense150000=3050000; card1800000 naqdga qo‘shilmaydi. Refund, opening float va discrepancy alohida satrlar bilan reconcile.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: 3200000 naqd −150000 xarajat =3050000; karta naqd qoldiqqa qo‘shilmaydi

steps.title: Draftda default present, faqat submitdan keyin tasdiqlangan davomat yaratish
steps.acceptance: Draft default present ota-onaga xabar yubormaydi; submit har student uchun unique result; kechikish holati distinct; teacher bo‘lmagan actor rad.

steps.title: client operation UUID, expected version va lesson_id+student_id orqali dedup yozish
steps.acceptance: Bir operation UUID retransmitda oldingi natija; boshqa body shu UUID bilan conflict. Batchda har op natijasi qaytadi va SQLite faqat ackdan keyin synced.

steps.title: Eski Excelni rad etish, Teacher tasdig‘ini himoyalash va Admin sababli override yozish
steps.acceptance: Stale Excel409 va per-row conflict; Teacher tasdiqini Admin faqat sababli override qiladi; blind last-write-wins yo‘q; teng versionli ikki write biri yutadi.

steps.title: Tasdiqlangan absence/late hodisasi, trial activation va billingga bog‘lash
steps.acceptance: Submitted event trialni bir marta aktiv qiladi; absence correction yangi event/audit beradi; oldingi jo‘natilgan xabar o‘chirildi deb da’vo qilinmaydi.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Eski Excel yangi mobil davomatni buzmaydi; retransmit yangi hodisa yaratmaydi

steps.title: DB outboxni lease bilan olish, bounded retry va dead-letter holatini yozish
steps.acceptance: Worker DB commitdan oldin yiqilsa lease tugagach retry; tashqi senddan keyin yiqilsa duplicate ehtimoli kuzatiladi; poison event DLQga, qolganlari davom etadi.

steps.title: Markaz vaqtida 09:00 va’da eslatmasi, to‘langan qarzni qayta tekshirish
steps.acceptance: Center local09:00da due debt qayta hisoblanadi; payment qilingan promisega xabar yo‘q; worker ertalab offline bo‘lsa catch-up siyosati bo‘yicha bir marta.

steps.title: 20 daqiqada davomat yo‘q bo‘lsa ping, dars tugaganda Admin escalation yozish
steps.acceptance: 20 daqiqada submitted bo‘lmasa bitta ping; cancelled lesson yoki substitute eski teacherga ping bermaydi; lesson endda Admin escalation bir marta.

steps.title: Billing, smena, trial no-show follow-up va missed job catch-upni idempotent qilish
steps.acceptance: Ikki worker bir vaqt billing jobni ishga tushirsa bitta effect; timezone/clock boundary, restart catch-up va disabled center siyosati sinovlangan. Trial no-show follow-up vazifasi yaratiladi.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Worker to‘xtab qaytsa hodisalar yo‘qolmaydi; bekor qarzga eslatma ketmaydi

steps.title: Bir martalik invite va Telegram contact.user_id tekshiruvi bilan vasiy bog‘lash
steps.acceptance: Contact user_id yuboruvchiga teng emas →rad; invite single-use va expiry bor; qayta linkingda eski chat huquqi bekor; guardian children serverdan aniqlanadi.

steps.title: Guardian so‘rovlari va Director approval callbacklarini backend command API orqali ulash
steps.acceptance: Callbackda student IDni almashtirish rad; unlinkdan keyin eski callback ma’lumot bermaydi; Director approve callback role/request version va replay tekshiradi.

steps.title: Kvitansiya, absence, late, xavfsizlik va smena xabarlarini navbatdan yuborish
steps.acceptance: Paid receipt, absence/late, discount approval request, reversal alert va shift report shablonlari event IDga bog‘langan; demo recipient allowlist mavjud.

steps.title: 429 retry_after, 403 blocked, unlinked va API accepted holatlarini saqlash
steps.acceptance: 429 retry_after,403 blocked,network timeout holatlari farqlanadi; accepted ≠read. Webhook secret tekshiriladi, Telegram update_id dedup; bot yo‘q guardian Admin ro‘yxatiga chiqadi.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Begona raqam bilan bola ochilmaydi; API accepted holati o‘qildi deb ko‘rsatilmaydi

steps.title: 15 soniyalik ro‘yxatga olish oqimi, guruh va guardian tanlashni qurish
steps.acceptance: Admin yangi student+guardian+group oqimini klaviaturada bajaradi; validation inputni yo‘qotmaydi; dublikat ogohlantirish ko‘rinadi; 15 soniya maqsadi real task timing bilan o‘lchanadi.

steps.title: To‘lov, va’da sanasi, kvitansiya va tuzatish so‘rovini qurish
steps.acceptance: Double click bitta payment; pending/error/success holati; debt bo‘lsa promise majburiy; receipt va reversal request ko‘rinadi; closed shift/read-only write tugmasi izohli blok.

steps.title: Guruh, jadval, substitute, ballar va davomat ekranlarini qurish
steps.acceptance: Guruh/jadval/substitute/grade/attendance integratsiya qilingan; Teacher telefon ko‘rmaydi; unsaved draft ogohlantiradi; keyboard va mobil ekran tekshiriladi.

steps.title: Chegirma/refund tasdiqlash, kassa, qarz va audit ekranlarini qurish
steps.acceptance: Director approval, kassa, audit va qarzdor ekranlari real APIga ulangan; full financial/payroll/churn dashboard S18.04gacha PENDING_INTEGRATION, soxta raqam productionga chiqmaydi.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Rollar bo‘yicha end-to-end oqim; double click ikki to‘lov yaratmaydi; xato va loading holatlari bor

steps.title: Versiyali locked XLSX, hidden UUID, row version va yangi student uchun IDsiz shablon yaratish
steps.acceptance: Export hidden UUID+version; yangi student shabloni ID bo‘sh bo‘lishini qo‘llaydi; template_version va center binding bor. Protected sheet xavfsizlik deb qabul qilinmaydi.

steps.title: Ustun, tur, hajm, formula injection, duplicate, foreign UUID va stale versionni tekshirish
steps.acceptance: Zip bomb/hajm limit, formula cell, foreign center ID, duplicate row va schema mismatch rad; CSV/XLSX eksportdagi =,+,-,@ prefikslar xavfsiz matn.

steps.title: Qizil/yashil dry-run, qator xatosi, immutable upload hash va preview token yaratish
steps.acceptance: Dry-run DBni o‘zgartirmaydi; har row action/error ko‘rsatiladi; token user/center/file hash va expiryga bog‘langan; boshqa foydalanuvchi tokeni ishlamaydi.

steps.title: Tasdiqda hash/versionni yana tekshirish; atomik import, idempotency va audit yozish
steps.acceptance: Previewdan keyin version o‘zgarsa commit qayta tekshiradi; bir invalid row →atomik rad. Qabul limitidan katta fayl rad, transaction cheksiz emas; retry bitta import batch.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Previewdan keyin o‘zgargan qator conflict; xatoli fayl bazaga qisman tushmaydi; ism bo‘yicha match yo‘q

steps.title: Flutter staff login, xavfsiz token va role navigation yaratish
steps.acceptance: Token secure storage; logout account+center local namespace tozalanadi yoki himoyalangan pending disposition ko‘rsatiladi; Director/Teacher routing server rolega mos.

steps.title: SQLite draft, pending operation, retry metadata va minimal local data yaratish
steps.acceptance: Airplane mode draft→app kill→restartda saqlanadi; SQLite migratsiya eski pendingni yo‘qotmaydi; boshqa center account queue sini ko‘rmaydi.

steps.title: Foreground/manual sync, tarmoq qaytishi, conflict UI va qayta yuborishni yozish
steps.acceptance: Network flap, timeout after server commit va conflict409 qayta yuborish testlari; ACKsiz local delete yo‘q; expired session va license lock queue ni soxta synced qilmaydi.

steps.title: Teacher guruh/ball/davomat, Admin asosiy amallar va Director hisobotini yaratish
steps.acceptance: Teacher attendance/grades, Admin asosiy amallar mavjud; Director full report API S18.04da ulanadi. Foreground/manual sync kafolatlangan; OS background execution doimiy deb va’da qilinmaydi.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Airplane mode → app restart → reconnectda davomat saqlanadi; konflikt ko‘rinadi; logout eski akkaunt queue sini yubormaydi

steps.title: Kun/hafta/oy cash va accrued daromadni alohida, qarz va forecast hisoblash
steps.acceptance: Cash va accrual alohida; paymentdan oldin invoice qarz ko‘rsatadi; grant/refund/unapplied credit ikki hisoblanmaydi; date filter center timezone.

steps.title: Tasdiqlangan fixed/per lesson/percentage qoida, substitute ulushi va payroll snapshot yaratish
steps.acceptance: Fixed/per-lesson/percentage ACCEPTED qoida; substitute faqat haqiqiy dars haqini oladi; yopilgan payroll immutable snapshot, keyingi correction adjustment bilan.

steps.title: Sabab, teacher, cohort va davr bo‘yicha ketganlar hisobini yozish
steps.acceptance: Churn denominator, period/cohort va kursni tugatish alohida metrikasi hujjatlangan; teacher almashsa attribution effective sanaga mos.

steps.title: Vakolatli eksport va ledger reconciliation; web/mobile Director dashboardni haqiqiy report APIga ulash
steps.acceptance: Web va Flutter Director dashboard real finance/payroll/churn endpointga ulanadi; role-aware eksport ledger bilan reconcile. S15.04/S17.04 pending integrations yopiladi.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Hisobot ledger bilan teng; grant, refund va substitute maoshga tasdiqlangan qoida bo‘yicha ta’sir qiladi

steps.title: Alohida Vendor auth, MFA siyosati, center registri va audit bilan boshqaruv yaratish
steps.acceptance: Vendor auth center staff authdan alohida, kuchli autentifikatsiya va audit; listda student/ledger yo‘q; center credential/token logda yoki UI listingda ko‘rinmaydi.

steps.title: Signed license, expiry, grace va audited read-only o‘tishni yozish
steps.acceptance: Imzo va center ID mismatch license rad; expiry/grace policy versiyalangan; downgrade/upgrade auditda; private signing key centerga berilmaydi.

steps.title: API/worker/import/offline yozishlarni bloklash, login/read/export/backupni saqlash
steps.acceptance: Read-onlyda API/import/offline/worker moliyaviy write blok; login/read/export/backup va approved system telemetry allowlist; role bypass yo‘q.

steps.title: Vendor uzilishi, cache, soat siljishi va uzaytirishdan keyingi tiklanishni yozish
steps.acceptance: Vendor offline cached valid license bilan kelishilgan grace; renewdan keyin queued ops version/permission bilan qayta tekshiriladi, blind replay yo‘q.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Read-onlyni worker yoki sync orqali chetlab bo‘lmaydi; ma’lumot o‘chmaydi; xabar navbati siyosati sinovdan o‘tadi

steps.title: Har markazga alohida network, volumes, DB credentials, API va worker yaratish
steps.acceptance: A credentials bilan B DBga kira olmaydi; volumes/network alohida; service resource limits, health va restart policy bor; DB public port yopiq.

steps.title: Slug validation, preflight, BotFather token input, DNS/TLS tekshirish va qayta bajariladigan deploy yozish
steps.acceptance: Slug shell injection urinishlari rad; token CLI history/logga tushmaydi; BotFather bot creation manual precondition. DNS/TLS tayyor emasligi aniq; half deploy retry data o‘chirmaydi.

steps.title: Version pin, backup, migratsiya, health va app rollback protokolini yozish
steps.acceptance: Old release→new migration rehearsal, offsite backup va app compatibility tekshiriladi; failed migrationda avtomatik down yo‘q. App rollback faqat schema-compatible bo‘lsa.

steps.title: Login, bot webhook, storage va ikki markaz izolyatsiyasini tekshirish
steps.acceptance: Yangi center staff login+webhook+storage smoke; A teacher B API/receipt/importga kira olmaydi. Bu qadamdan oldin real mijoz deployi taqiqlangan, synthetic staging ishlatiladi.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Ikki markaz testida baza/fayl/bot aralashmaydi; yarim deploydan qayta ishga tushirish xavfsiz

steps.title: Encrypted DB dump va kerakli fayllarni alohida offsite saqlash; retention va checksum yozish
steps.acceptance: DB+attachments manifest, encryption, retention va checksum; backup destination alohida credential. Missing/partial upload alert; secret key dump bilan bir joyda emas.

steps.title: Toza muhitga restore, versiya mosligi va nazorat summalarini tekshirish
steps.acceptance: Yangi muhitda DB+files restore, row count va ledger reconciliation; bot outbound avval disabled, stale jobs replay nazorati; RPO/RTO o‘lchanadi.

steps.title: DB, queue age, disk, backup age, TLS va login xatolari monitoringini yozish
steps.acceptance: Disk full, DB down, oldest queue age, backup age, TLS expiry simulated alert; alertga recipient/runbook va dedup bor; logs PII redact.

steps.title: Incident, kalit rotatsiyasi, Telegram backup opsiyasi va restore mashqini hujjatlashtirish
steps.acceptance: Lost key, leaked bot token, center down va failed upgrade bo‘yicha aniq recovery; Telegram opsiyasi privacy/size qaroridan keyin. Drill dalili bor, nazariy runbookning o‘zi PASS emas.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Zaxiradan alohida muhitda to‘liq restore qilinadi; RPO/RTO o‘lchanadi; kalit backup bilan birga saqlanmaydi

steps.title: 240 sintetik student, 14 group, 6 teacher, discount/grant/debt va reproducible random seed yaratish
steps.acceptance: 240 synthetic student,14 group,6 teacher invariant; seed deterministik; 50%/grant/debt/trial/freeze/substitute fixture mavjud; hech qanday real contact yo‘q.

steps.title: Faqat DEMO flag va alohida DBda qayta tiklash; productionda qat’iy rad etish
steps.acceptance: Production envda reset abort; faqat DEMO=true yetarli emas: demo DB identity ham tasdiqlanadi; demo outbound recipient allowlist bilan cheklangan.

steps.title: 3 daqiqada virtual farzand, absence va 400000 so‘mlik kvitansiya ssenariysini yozish
steps.acceptance: 3 daqiqalik ssenariy virtual child absence+400000 payment receipt bilan; network/Telegram uzilishi uchun oldindan yozilgan fallback; latency o‘lchanadi, 1 soniya va’da emas.

steps.title: Video ssenariysi, help registry, UI playback/fallback va haqiqiy content readinessni boshqarish
steps.acceptance: 45 soniyalik video ssenariyi bilan birga UI help registry va playback/fallback integratsiyasi; real video URL/assets yo‘q bo‘lsa CONTENT_PENDING, tayyor video deb da’vo qilinmaydi.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Demo kontaktlar real shaxslarga yubormaydi; tasdiqli demo chatda to‘liq ssenariy ishlaydi

steps.title: Enrollment→billing→partial payment→promise→receipt→refund to‘liq oqimini sinash
steps.acceptance: Enrollment→invoice→300000 partial→promise→200000 payment→receipt→reversal ketma-ketligi API/UI orqali ledger bilan mos; barcha asosiy rollar UAT.

steps.title: Offline, queue crash, double submit, stale Excel, license va restore regressiyasini sinash
steps.acceptance: Offline sync, crash, stale Excel, license lock, restore va release upgrade fault injection; rollbackdan so‘ng old client ham qo‘llangan kontraktda ishlaydi.

steps.title: RBAC, cross-center, guardian unlink va eksportdagi maxfiylikni sinash
steps.acceptance: Cross-center, IDOR, revoked guardian, teacher export, vendor privilege va malicious Excel sinovlari; unauthorized mutationda DB side effect nol.

steps.title: Pilot UAT, ma’lum kamchilik, performance o‘lchovi va rollback qarorini yozish
steps.acceptance: P0/P1 ochiq bo‘lsa NO_GO; accepted P2 risk egasi bilan. Release artifact digest, migration, backup drill, workload/latency va real UAT dalili release manifestga biriktirilgan.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Pul yo‘qolishi, begona ma’lumot yoki restore xatosi ochiq bo‘lsa release bloklanadi

steps.title: 1–3 kun eski ma’lumotni tozalash, opening balance va markaz bilan reconciliation qilish
steps.acceptance: Import oldidan frozen source snapshot, opening debt/credit mapping va line totals; importdan keyin markaz imzoli reconciliation; tarixiy paymentni yangi tushum deb kiritmaslik.

steps.title: 4–7 kun Admin 1 soat, Teacher 15 daqiqa, ota-ona botga ulanishini o‘rgatish
steps.acceptance: Admin1 soat/Teacher15 daqiqa amaliy topshiriq bilan; bot adoptionning denominator va foizi yozilgan; unlinked parents uchun call list; video mavjudligi tekshirilgan.

steps.title: 2–4 hafta haftada ikki audit; kuzatuv→ustuvorlik→patch→regression→natijani o‘lchash
steps.acceptance: Haftada ikki auditda PII-minimal metrikalar; issue→fix→regression→deploy→measured outcome. Tugmani topish >5s real kuzatuv, logdan taxmin emas.

steps.title: 2–3 oy maosh/kassa sign-off, case study roziligi va keyingi 4–5 markaz rollout mezonlari
steps.acceptance: 1–3 oylik real davr va birinchi payroll/cash sign-off; case study uchun alohida rozilik; 4–5 markazdan oldin support capacity, restore va upgrade readiness tasdiqlangan.

steps.title: Review, regressiya va handoff
steps.acceptance: Birinchi oy hisoblari rahbar bilan solishtirilgan; muammolar egasi va patch natijasi yozilgan
